versions.content: When IdsM_Init is called in initialized state, the IdsM mod- ule shall not re-initialize its internal variables. It shall instead call Det_ReportError with the error code IDSM_E_ALREADY_INITIALIZED if development error reporting is enabled (see IdsMDevErrorDetect ).
